observations: Stand-alone one-sentence incidents were caught by nearly all notes, while faults recorded only in test tables were mostly missed, most sharply in the kernarg notes D and F.
On the multi-phase depth report, notes A, B and C all led with the earlier phases and left the Cactus delta 0 result out of their verdicts.
Weak FACT choices were usually true but peripheral numbers such as peak VRAM or wall time, as in the sharp notes B, D and E, rather than wrong ones.
The most serious verdict error came from carrying a number across arms, as in Ornith note D applying the Qwen3.5-35B EMULATION speed to Ornith on Sly.
Syntheses P, R and S overclaimed with words like best-graded or only, and T and U reported no conflicts although in-scope reports clearly disagree.
